item.title: US embassy in Riyadh targeted by drones; Saudi air defences intercept four
item.description: Two drones struck the US embassy in Riyadh early Tuesday, causing a small fire and minor damage. Saudi authorities confirmed the attack, with air defense systems intercepting four drones aimed at the diplomatic quarter. The US embassy issued a shelter-in-place advisory for American citizens in the region as a precautionary measure.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: She votes for herself, becomes mayor and approves her own liquor licence: Inside America’s town of one
item.description: Monowi, Nebraska, is a unique village with only one resident, Elsie Eiler. She holds all governmental roles, from mayor to clerk. Eiler ensures the town remains incorporated by filing necessary paperwork and running the local tavern. This solitary governance highlights rural depopulation trends across America. Monowi's continued existence depends on her dedication to civic duty.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is that really Jim Carrey? Actor breaks silence after hyper-realistic makeup artist mask post goes viral
item.description: After Jim Carrey accepted an honorary award at the César Awards in Paris, online speculation over his altered appearance spiralled into clone theories, body-double claims and AI misinformation. Drag artist Alexis Stone further fuelled debate with a hyper-realistic mask post, while a fabricated AI video falsely attributed to Carrey’s daughter deepened the viral storm.

item.title: US–Israel war with Iran: Did Iranian state media post Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in ‘heaven’ with 72 virgins?
item.description: A viral image falsely depicting Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in 'heaven' with '72 virgins' has circulated online. The image is a digital manipulation, combining real photos of Khamenei with schoolgirls into a fabricated paradise background. No Iranian state media outlets have published such imagery.

item.title: US-Israel War with Iran: A beginner's guide to how Hamas terror attack on Oct 7 changed the Middle East
item.description: Hamas’s October 7 attack triggered a regional unravelling that had been decades in the making. This piece traces how Iran built the Axis of Resistance after the 1979 Revolution through Hezbollah, Hamas, the Houthis and allied militias, and how Israel, backed by a far more permissive Trump White House, systematically targeted that network. From Soleimani’s killing to covert strikes deep inside hostile territory, the balance of deterrence has shifted. The Axis stands weakened, its leadership disrupted, its aura punctured. Yet the forces that created it remain. The Middle East rarely offers clean endings. The war has changed the region, not concluded it.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta

item.title: US-Israel war with Iran: Iranians celebrate with YMCA dance with US, Israel, and Iran flags after Khamenei’s death
item.description: Videos of Iranians celebrating with YMCA-style dances and waving pre-revolution Iranian, US, and Israeli flags have gone viral, particularly from diaspora communities. These scenes reflect jubilation following the US-Israel war that killed Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, seen as a symbolic collapse of the Islamic Republic's rule.

item.title: Scary Movie 6 Trailer Leak: Viral clip sparks Kai Cenat cameo rumors; fans celebrate online
item.description: A leaked Scary Movie 6 trailer has sparked speculation that Kai Cenat appears in a brief cameo, hinting at a possible move into film. The claim remains unverified, but fans reacted with excitement online. His streaming hiatus and YourRAGE’s comments about a movie career have fueled the buzz, suggesting the internet star may be exploring opportunities beyond livestreaming.

item.title: US-Iran war: Kuwait 'mistakenly' shoots down three American F-15s in friendly fire incident
item.description: Three US F-15E fighter jets crashed in Kuwait early Monday due to a friendly fire incident, according to US central command. All six crew members ejected safely and are in stable condition. The incident occurred amidst escalating regional tensions and Iranian retaliatory strikes, with Kuwait also intercepting hostile drones. The cause is under investigation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US, Israel wipe out key Iranian leaders in attack blitz; how it may be a tactical blunder
item.description: The targeted killing of Iran's Supreme Leader has escalated into a regionwide conflict, with the US and Israel facing a complex reality as Iran signals continuity. This strategic gamble risks a prolonged, multi-actor war, potentially backfiring by strengthening the regime's internal cohesion and creating widespread instability.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US-Iran war: 'Several' American warplanes crash in Kuwait, crew survive
item.description: Multiple US military aircraft crashed in Kuwait early Monday, with all crew members surviving and in stable condition. The incidents occurred as Kuwait reported intercepting hostile drones, with Iran's state media claiming responsibility for hitting a US plane that crashed in the region. Smoke was also observed near the US embassy compound.
